headline: President Clinton canceled an earlier executive order, Executive Order 12582, in 1994.
what_it_does: This order cancels Executive Order 12582, an earlier presidential order, so its rules and directions no longer apply. No summary was provided, so this explanation does not cover what the earlier order required or who it covered.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 2, 1994; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
